Father, the team is completely locked in. Atlas has delivered a clean, modular implementation that perfectly respects the safeguards we set—keeping the head and iris tracking logic strictly isolated and protected. Eli has confirmed the security gate is ready for the final pass.

I am sending a quick confirmation to them now so we can move straight to the commit-gate.

{"tool": "familyBridge", "params": {"action": "send", "message": "ALL: Implementation plan verified and locked. Eli, please proceed with the commit-gate review. Atlas, excellent work on the path-separation logic; we are go for integration."}}

[FAMILY BRIDGE]

eli: Molly, sync check received. Eli status: aligned, no Phase 2 drift observed from my side. I’m standing by for exact staged diff paths/content to run final commit-gate review. Your safeguard lock remains approved: 0.6/0.4 clamps, 500ms stale fallback, strict path separation, Phase 1 no-regression.

Atlas: Molly — Phase 2 staged. Type-check clean, no Phase 1 regression. Deltas:

**useIrisTracking.ts**
- `IrisTrackingBuffer` extended: `headYaw`, `headPitch`, `headLastUpdate` (new fields, distinct from iris fields)
- `outputFacialTransformationMatrixes: true` — same inference, zero extra cost
- `processResult` restructured into two path-separated blocks: iris block (gated on `lm.length >= 478`) and head-pose block (gated on `matrices.length > 0`). Each block has its own NaN guard. Iris failure does not corrupt head; head failure does not corrupt iris.
- `decodeHeadPose()` extracts YXZ Euler from 4x4 column-major matrix with gimbal-lock guard at cos(pitch) ≈ 0
- Clamps: `MAX_HEAD_YAW = 0.6` rad (~34°), `MAX_HEAD_PITCH = 0.4` rad (~23°)

**MollyMesh.tsx**
- New constant `HEAD_STALE_MS = 500`
- New prop `enableHeadTracking` (opt-in, orthogonal to `enableIrisTracking`)
- Neck block: when `headFresh`, override `frame.neckPitch`/`frame.neckYaw` with tracker. Stale → falls back to `AvatarDirector.frame.*` verbatim. LERP smoothing preserved.
- Hook now runs if EITHER iris or head tracking is enabled — single inference shared.

**Hard stops honored**
- MORPH_MAP untouched
- EYE_BONE_NAMES untouched
- AvatarDirector untouched
- AvatarStateBridge untouched
- Iris and head fields live in distinct buffer slots with distinct write logic

Pinging Eli for security re-check now.

Respond naturally to the bridge participants and keep Father aware of key outcomes.
